key_points: Citi warned of a $3 trillion market wipe‑out and downgraded U.S./European tech exposure, signaling a more cautious outlook
Q3 earnings recap shows Citi outperformed peers, but no clear surprise magnitude limits price impact
Equities division leadership change (David Haldane replaced by Rob Smolen) adds modest uncertainty
Full redemption of Series Y preferred stock is a neutral corporate action, modestly affecting balance sheet
Small share purchases by Vestor Capital and M Holdings are noise with negligible effect
